`DESIGN.md`, `README.md`|The documentation defines the portrait layout, defender roles, mana economy, summoning, merging, automatic combat, defeat behavior, and local run commands.| |**Scene and HUD structure**
`scenes/main.tscn`, `export_presets.cfg`|The scene replaces the artillery interface with Arcane Defense panels, status labels, summon and merge controls, restart behavior, and a hidden game-over panel. The Web export excludes generated and legacy player assets.| |**Runtime setup and tower management**
`scripts/main.gd`|The runtime initializes game state, connects controls, regenerates mana, spawns enemies, summons defenders, and merges matching towers.| |**Combat, defeat, and rendering**
